And in it are 6 seifim: One should not knead in a place of sunlight, and on a cloudy day it is forbidden under the entire open sky, because on a cloudy day the sun is everywhere. {Rama: And therefore they are accustomed to be careful not to knead opposite an open window even where there is no sun, lest it become cloudy without his realizing it (Terumat HaDeshen siman 193).
